provider_contract.provider: European Patent Office Open Patent Services

query_streams.cql: (ta all "brain computer interface") or (ta all "brain machine interface") or (ta all "brain neural interface")
query_streams.purpose: Explicit BCI and brain-machine-interface vocabulary stratum.

query_streams.cql: ((ta=intracortical) or (ta=electrocorticography) or (ta=ECoG)) and ((ta=decoder) or (ta=decoding) or (ta=interface) or (ta=neuroprosthesis))
query_streams.purpose: Invasive cortical-interface and decoding vocabulary stratum.

query_streams.cql: ((ta all "deep brain stimulation") or (ta=neuromodulation) or (ta=neurostimulation)) and ((ta=adaptive) or (ta all "closed loop")) and ((ta=algorithm) or (ta=classifier) or (ta=prediction) or (ta all "machine learning"))
query_streams.purpose: Adaptive and algorithmically controlled neuromodulation stratum.

query_streams.cql: ((ta=neural) or (ta=brain) or (ta=cortical)) and ((ta=decoder) or (ta=decoding)) and ((ta all "machine learning") or (ta all "deep learning") or (ta=transformer) or (ta all "artificial intelligence"))
query_streams.purpose: AI-enabled neural decoding that may not use BCI terminology.

query_streams.cql: ((ta=retinal) or (ta=retina) or (ta=visual)) and ((ta=prosthesis) or (ta=neuroprosthesis) or (ta=implant)) and ((ta=algorithm) or (ta all "image processing") or (ta all "machine learning"))
query_streams.purpose: Visual and retinal neuroprosthesis patents with an explicit computational role.

query_streams.cql: ((ta=EEG) or (ta=electroencephalography) or (ta=neural) or (ta all "brain signal")) and ((ta=attention) or (ta=emotion) or (ta=fatigue) or (ta all "cognitive state") or (ta all "mental state")) and ((ta=classification) or (ta=prediction) or (ta=inference) or (ta all "machine learning"))
query_streams.purpose: Grey-area neural inference stratum for attention, emotion, fatigue, cognitive-state or mental-state applications outside an assumed medical-use boundary.

query_streams.cql: ((ta=EEG) or (ta=neural) or (ta all "brain signal")) and ((ta=biometric) or (ta=authentication) or (ta=identification) or (ta=identity))
query_streams.purpose: Grey-area neural biometric, authentication and identity inference stratum.

query_streams.cql: ((ta=EEG) or (ta=neural) or (ta all "brain signal")) and ((ta=worker) or (ta=workplace) or (ta=operator) or (ta=driver)) and ((ta=attention) or (ta=fatigue) or (ta=alertness) or (ta=performance))
query_streams.purpose: Grey-area occupational and operator-state inference stratum where first-order agency/privacy implications may arise without medical-use framing.
Known-applicant watch for publications not recovered by vocabulary strata; applicant-name matches remain unresolved entity/relevance leads.

review_questions: Is the patent publication materially relevant to a direct NeuroAI system, enabling technology, or declared grey-area capability?
Is the DOCDB publication identity exact and unambiguous?
What applicant/assignee identity, if any, can be resolved without fuzzy automatic merging?
Does the record support only an invention/publication claim, or is there separate evidence for implementation, deployment or commercial use?
Does a grey-area candidate plausibly concern privacy, agency, autonomy, identity or mental-integrity implications that warrant expert review?
What inference is prohibited by the patent record alone?

boundary: This programme defines bounded EPO OPS patent-publication discovery. Patent publication is evidence that a patent document exists in provider data, not evidence that the claimed invention works, is implemented or deployed, is safe/effective, is legally valid or enforceable, provides freedom to operate, maps to a current applicant without resolution, or establishes a system-level ethical/regulatory conclusion.
